questions.text: What is the highest possible score in the original Pac-Man?
questions.fact: Billy Mitchell played the first perfect game in 1999, after almost six hours.

questions.text: In what year was Tetris created?
questions.fact: Alexey Pajitnov made it in Moscow, on a Soviet computer that could only show text.

questions.text: How old was Shigeru Miyamoto when Donkey Kong came out?
questions.fact: Donkey Kong was Mario's debut, back when he was called Jumpman.

questions.text: How many levels does the original Super Mario Bros. have?
questions.fact: Eight worlds of four levels each. Warp pipes let you skip whole worlds.

questions.text: Approximately how many PlayStation 2 units were sold worldwide? (millions)
questions.fact: It is the best-selling home console in history.

questions.text: How many shades could the original Game Boy screen show?
questions.fact: Four greenish shades, on a screen with no backlight.

questions.text: What was the top clock speed of the Super Nintendo's processor? (MHz)
questions.fact: A phone today is thousands of times faster.

questions.text: How many action buttons did the Atari 2600 controller have?
questions.fact: Everything else was done with the joystick, which moved in eight directions.

questions.text: In what year was Nintendo founded?
questions.fact: It started out making Japanese playing cards called hanafuda.

questions.text: How many years did Duke Nukem Forever take from announcement to release?
questions.fact: It was announced in 1997 and only reached stores in 2011.

questions.text: Approximately how many copies had Minecraft sold by 2023? (millions)
questions.fact: It is the best-selling video game in history.

questions.text: How many players drop onto the island in a standard Fortnite Battle Royale match?
questions.fact: The last player or team standing wins.

questions.text: How many blocks tall is a Minecraft world since version 1.18?
questions.fact: The world goes from layer -64 up to 319.

questions.text: In what year was World of Warcraft released?
questions.fact: It peaked at more than 12 million subscribers at once, in 2010.
